## The Goal

I am coming from a background in Computer Science and Mathematics, building toward a career in quantitative research and algorithmic trading. While academic coursework provides the theoretical foundation, the gap I want to close here is visible, hands-on quantitative work: exploring signals, building backtests, evaluating risk and understanding the market mechanics behind them. 

This site is where I document that process in public.

## What to Expect

This space will serve as an open notebook for my research. Instead of following a rigid format, these notes will adapt to whatever problem I am currently trying to solve. Some posts will be deep mathematical explorations, while others might just be practical engineering notes on building financial infrastructure.

Generally, my writing will focus on:

- **Quantitative Research:** Explorations of time-series models, volatility forecasting and market dynamics.
- **Engineering:** The architecture and technical decisions behind my projects.
- **Thesis Updates:** Findings from my ongoing Bachelor's thesis on adaptive algorithmic trading systems and concept drift detection.

## Up Next

The first few notes will come straight from my thesis research. I will be covering topics like volatility, risk management and backtesting, among others.
